Watch Vyjantimala's amazing dance moves in this beautiful classical song 'Aa Bhi Ja Rasiya' is sung by Lata Mangeshkar & Manna Dey. Music composed by Adi Narayan Rao. Lyrics by Hasrat Jaipuri. Starring: Ashok Kumar, Vyjayantimala, Manoj Kumar, Nirupa Roy, Mehmood, Kanhaiya Lal, Shobha Khote, Mukri, Lalita Pawar, Anjali Devi. Directed by Inder Raj Anand.
